doctrine.name: Alex Amaro
doctrine.cpl_per_campaign: CPL is quoted per-campaign only. NEVER divide total spend by total leads ($200K/6,000≈$33 is NOT a CPL — it blends brand/awareness spend, B2C, and qualified B2B). B2C strong campaigns $4–$22; qualified B2B ~$40–$80 per scheduled appointment; refrigeration (~$1.50–$4) is the cheap exception.
doctrine.attribution_boundary: We claim leads + booked appointments + follow-up systems — NOT client revenue or ROAS (no post-booking visibility; closing is client-side). Downstream closes are lead-quality evidence only. 'Booked' means scheduled, not attended, unless a show is verified.
doctrine.degree_line: B.S. Business Administration, Marketing — Western Governors University (expected ~2027; transferring credit). Do NOT say 'in progress'. Associate's — University of Wisconsin–Oshkosh (conferred).
doctrine.ecom_framing: Six-figure college-grit story, founder-attested: 'Built and ran a six-figure Amazon/eBay business while attending college full-time — self-funding tuition.' Never quote $350K or 4.9-star.
doctrine.hubspot: Builds are GoHighLevel-only. HubSpot is certification-level — say 'HubSpot-certified (transferable)', never claim HubSpot client builds.
doctrine.clients_public: Anonymized client labels only on public surfaces ('a Montreal beauty brand', 'a UK commercial-refrigeration installer'). No client/patient PII ever.
